dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Japan Medical Association open-source clinic system), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux
evidence: COPY directives with .INC files typical of ORCA
LINKAGE SECTION with COPY COMMON-SPA and COPY CPORCSNYURECEDEN.INC
DISPLAY statements used for debug output
no COMP-3, no EXEC CICS/SQL, no IBM-specific extensions

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical clinic inpatient (nyuin) receipt/billing calculation subsystem for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: This subprogram (ORCSNYURECEDEN) retrieves and calculates inpatient medical billing account data for a given patient and assessment year-month. It checks parameters, reads patient master and inpatient account master records, and processes insurance combination and treatment fee data to produce billing calculation results.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with parameter passing via USING clause
OCCURS clauses for daily tables (up to 31 days)
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese EUC encoding but were decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake. The program is part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. File truncated at 16000 chars out of ~101KB total; full procedure division not visible but structure is clearly production-grade.
